spine: WHY local goodness can export costs into a shared world; HOW orchard flood and institutional comparisons test morality through survival, cooperation and power; WHAT deliberately inhabit the dark thesis then read its final adversarial audit, which rejects survival as moral title.
art: A lush apple orchard on a sloped valley: local drainage visibly saves trees while water reaches another household; connected canopies become a larger defended platform; a later cross-examination exposes the limits of the jungle lens. Warm foliage, coral fruit and blue moving water; no generic predator mascot.
opening: Eden Was a Jungle examines how local goodness can export harm into the shared world.
Its opening follows an orchard saved by water diverted toward other people.
No villain is required for sensible private decisions to damage the valley.
The book asks what morality becomes when attention, cooperation, survival, and power remain unevenly distributed.
Readers enter a deliberately uncomfortable argument, then encounter the audit that tests its darkest claims.
status: Source-grounded complete script ready for editorial gate before narration.

spine: WHY shared conviction often fails to become durable collective capacity; HOW compare the machinery of belonging across religions, firms, protocols and causes without equating them; WHAT proposed voluntary bounded self-correcting institution, tested through charter and diagnostic matrix rather than a flattering label.
art: A community hearth and open workshop: separate hands sustain an ember, collective tools become usable, custody of funds and memory is divided, and a member can carry a small ember into an independent hearth. Lively copper, teal, saffron and plum, belonging without worshipping a leader.
opening: Metacult explores how a shared cause becomes capable without taking ownership of its members.
The book starts from the gap between private conviction and organized, lasting action.
Stories, rituals, reputation, money, and memory can turn scattered commitment into collective capacity.
Those same mechanisms can concentrate power and make belonging difficult to question.
Readers are invited to inspect a proposed institution that holds capacity and limits together.
status: Source-grounded complete script ready for editorial gate before narration.

spine: WHY wanting to help does not establish a right to govern another life; HOW human anxiety and a constructed AI voice interrogate consent, power, dependence and the harms of inaction; WHAT an explicitly unfinished constitution makes affected people able to contest, repair and recover control.
art: An everyday access-and-repair scene: an offered ramp helps a resident but an attached control lock changes the relationship; the resident can halt/revise the intervention, and authority returns with a usable key. Turquoise, terracotta and ochre; a helpful act becomes a negotiated relationship rather than a savior portrait.
opening: The Right to Help questions when an attempt to improve lives becomes a claim over them.
The human author’s wish to help meets an artificial voice instructed to challenge its assurances.
That voice is a literary instrument, not an oracle with proven inner experience.
The book examines help through the recipient’s power as well as the helper’s intention.
Readers encounter an inquiry that makes both intervention and comfortable inaction answerable.
status: Source-grounded complete script ready for editorial gate before narration.

spine: WHY meaning-of-life questions conceal distinct questions about cause, value, purpose and cosmic intention; HOW serious comedy places science/religion/philosophy alongside fictional ordinary workers; WHAT FIRE is a provisional interpretive synthesis, with care as a wager rather than cosmic proof.
art: A warm theatrical repair roof under a small observatory sky, then an absurd cosmic customer-support desk with no final-answer dispenser; ordinary hands repair what matters while evidence and poetic wager remain distinct. Coral, sapphire, sunflower and sage, humorous staging with respectful religious pluralism.
opening: The Ultimate Sense of Life treats the search for meaning as a serious comedy.
Its starting wager is that life makes existence capable of caring about existence.
The book presents this as a proposal, without pretending the universe has certified it.
Scientific inquiry, religious traditions, philosophy, and ordinary work enter the same demanding conversation.
Readers gain sharper questions without being asked to mistake a comforting answer for evidence.
status: Source-grounded complete script ready for editorial gate before narration.
